trigger: Use when designing, building or reviewing a native macOS app's interface in SwiftUI, even when the request only asks for a feature or a fix: a menu command, a shortcut, an empty state.

includes: scenes, navigation, toolbars, menus, keyboard and focus
type, color, materials, layout, states, settings and accessibility on macOS
excludes: design rules that hold on every platform
a product's own recorded design decisions, such as brand colors or where settings open
